features.statement: Document title is a short 'brand – descriptor' form rather than a long descriptive sentence.
The main welcome headline is the page's single h1, with a clear heading hierarchy beneath it.
Uses semantic landmark elements (header, nav, main, aside) for page structure.
All images carry descriptive alt text, including meaningful content-describing alt on logos and content images.
Hero is a solid green panel with white headline, intro paragraphs, two CTA buttons and an enlarged badge image in a white circle.
Typography relies solely on the system font stack, with no web fonts or icon fonts.
Body text is 16px with generous line height; h2 headings are larger and bolder.
Navigation uses title-case labels without chevrons, with the final item styled as a solid green button.
Palette is built on deep greens, with a dark green utility bar and green-tinted charcoal text instead of neutral grays.
Header band is clean white background.
Page is stacked full-width horizontal bands (hero, link strip, cards, newsletter/calendar, link cards, footer), producing a taller page.
Quick links are presented as a single horizontal row with a small uppercase label.
Layout is built with CSS grid and flexbox in a narrower, indented centered container.
Content blocks are white bordered rounded cards with an icon beside a heading and text, ending in a 'Read More →' link on its own line.
The same badge image is reused at different sizes in multiple places, with small card icons.
Newsletter is a large green rounded panel with an email input and Subscribe button.
Calendar is a larger rounded card with plain text navigation links rather than a table widget.
Footer link groups appear as underlined green links inside white bordered cards on a light background above a dark footer.
Dark green-charcoal footer has left-aligned copyright and repeats the main navigation row with a divider.
Decoration is minimal: a single gradient and one box shadow, with no transitions, animations or transforms.
Uses more rounded corners and larger radii than sharp-cornered designs.
Copy is calm in tone, with no exclamation marks and title-case headings.
Markup is lean and hand-written with minimal scripts, stylesheets and inline styles.
